summary: A husband may cancel a messenger who brings the get for him. But once the wife's own messenger receives the get for her, the husband can no longer take it back.

chunks.en: Someone who says, "Receive this get for my wife,"
chunks.st: With regard to one who says to another: Receive this bill of divorce for my wife,

chunks.en: or "Take this get to my wife,"
chunks.st: or: Deliver this bill of divorce to my wife as my agent,

chunks.en: if he wants to take it back,
chunks.st: if the husband seeks to retract his designation and cancel the agency,

chunks.en: he may take it back. A woman who said,
chunks.st: he can retract it until the document reaches his wife’s possession. However, in the case of a woman who said to an agent:

chunks.en: "Receive my get for me,"
chunks.st: Receive my bill of divorce for me,

chunks.en: if the husband wants to take it back,
chunks.st: and the husband handed the bill of divorce to her agent, if the husband seeks to retract his decision to divorce his wife upon receipt of the bill of divorce by the agent,

chunks.en: he may not take it back.
chunks.st: he cannot retract it.
chunks.stMore: Once the bill of divorce is transferred to her agent, its legal status is like that of a bill of divorce that was handed directly to her, and the divorce takes effect immediately.

chunks.en: So, if the husband said to him,
chunks.st: Therefore, if the husband said to the agent whom the woman designated to receive the bill of divorce:

chunks.en: "I do not want you to receive it for her,
chunks.st: I do not want [ee ifshi] for you to receive the bill of divorce for her;

chunks.en: but take it and give it to her,"
chunks.st: rather, deliver it and give it to her,

chunks.en: if he wants to take it back,
chunks.st: then if the husband seeks to retract his designation and cancel the agency,

chunks.he: יַחֲזֹר. רַבָּן שִׁמְעוֹן בֶּן גַּמְלִיאֵל אוֹמֵר,
chunks.en: he may take it back. Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel says,
chunks.st: he can retract it until it reaches his wife’s possession. Since the husband does not agree to have the divorce take effect upon receipt by his wife’s agent, he changes the designation of the agent and designates him as his own agent for delivery. Therefore, the divorce takes effect only when the bill of divorce reaches his wife’s possession. Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel says:

chunks.en: even if she says, "Take my get for me,"
chunks.st: Even a woman who did not instruct the agent: Receive my bill of divorce for me but says: Take my bill of divorce for me,
chunks.stMore: thereby designates the agent as an agent of receipt on her behalf. Therefore,

chunks.en: if he wants to take it back,
chunks.st: if after handing the bill of divorce to the agent the husband seeks to retract his decision and cancel the agency,

chunks.en: he may not take it back.
chunks.st: he cannot retract it.

summary: When a woman's messenger receives her get, two pairs of witnesses must tell what happened. The mishnah also teaches who may receive the get of a young girl.

chunks.en: A woman who said,
chunks.st: A woman who said to an agent:

chunks.en: "Receive my get for me,"
chunks.st: Receive my bill of divorce for me,

chunks.en: needs two groups of witnesses:
chunks.st: requires two sets of witnesses
chunks.stMore: to confirm that she was divorced when the agent received the bill of divorce. She requires

chunks.en: two who say, "She said it in front of us," and two
chunks.st: two witnesses who say: In our presence she said to the agent: Receive my bill of divorce on my behalf, and two

chunks.en: who say, "In front of us he received it and tore it."
chunks.explain: Tearing the get shows it was used.
chunks.st: who say: In our presence the agent received the bill of divorce and tore it.

chunks.en: Even if the same people are the first ones and the last ones,
chunks.st: This testimony is effective even if two people are the first pair of witnesses and the same two are the latter pair of witnesses,

chunks.en: or one from the first and one
chunks.st: or if there is one witness from the first pair of witnesses and one witness

chunks.en: from the last, and one more joins with them.
chunks.st: from the latter pair, and one additional witness joins with them as the second witness in both testimonies.

chunks.en: A young girl who is engaged:
chunks.st: With regard to a betrothed young woman,

chunks.en: she or her father may receive her get.
chunks.st: she and her father are each eligible to receive her bill of divorce,
chunks.stMore: and the divorce takes effect at the moment that either of them receives the bill of divorce.

chunks.en: Rabbi Yehuda said,
chunks.st: Rabbi Yehuda said:

chunks.en: two hands cannot take for one person together,
chunks.st: Two hands do not have the right to acquire an item on behalf of one person as one.

chunks.he: אֶלָּא אָבִיהָ מְקַבֵּל אֶת גִּטָּהּ בִּלְבָד.
chunks.en: rather only her father receives her get.
chunks.st: Rather, her father alone receives her bill of divorce on her behalf.
chunks.stMore: And there is another principle:

chunks.he: וְכֹל שֶׁאֵינָהּ יְכוֹלָה לִשְׁמֹר אֶת גִּטָּהּ,
chunks.en: And any girl who cannot guard her get
chunks.st: Any female who is unable to safeguard her bill of divorce

chunks.en: cannot be divorced.
chunks.st: is unable to be divorced.

summary: A young girl cannot make a messenger, but her father can. The mishnah also teaches what happens when a messenger gives or receives the get in a different place than he was told.

chunks.en: A young girl who said, "Receive my get for me,"
chunks.st: In the case of a minor girl who said to an agent: Receive my bill of divorce for me,

chunks.he: אֵינוֹ גֵט עַד שֶׁיַּגִּיעַ גֵּט לְיָדָהּ.
chunks.en: it is not a get until it reaches her hand.
chunks.st: it is not a valid bill of divorce until the bill of divorce reaches her possession.

chunks.en: So if the husband wants to take it back,
chunks.st: Therefore, if the husband seeks to retract his decision before his wife receives the bill of divorce,

chunks.en: he may take it back, because a child cannot make a messenger.
chunks.st: he can retract it, as a minor does not designate an agent.
chunks.stMore: Consequently, the agent is not an agent for receipt, and the divorce does not take effect when the husband hands the document to the agent. The agent is an agent for delivery, and the divorce takes effect when the bill of divorce enters the wife’s possession.

chunks.en: But if her father said to him,
chunks.st: And if her father said to the agent:

chunks.en: "Go and receive my daughter's get for her,"
chunks.st: Go out and receive my daughter’s bill of divorce on her behalf, then

chunks.en: if the husband wants to take it back,
chunks.st: if the husband seeks to retract his decision,

chunks.en: he may not take it back.
chunks.st: he cannot retract it.
chunks.stMore: As a father can receive the bill of divorce on behalf of his minor daughter, he can designate an agent for receipt, and the divorce takes effect when the husband hands the document to the agent.

chunks.en: Someone who says, "Give this get
chunks.st: With regard to one who says to an agent: Give this bill of divorce

chunks.en: to my wife in such-and-such a place,"
chunks.st: to my wife in such and such a place,

chunks.en: and he gave it to her in another place,
chunks.st: if the agent deviated and gave it to her in another place

chunks.en: it is not valid. But "She is in such-and-such a place,"
chunks.st: the divorce is invalid. However, if he said to the agent: Give this bill of divorce to my wife, she is in such and such a place,
chunks.stMore: without explicitly instructing the agent to give her the document there,

chunks.en: and he gave it to her in another place,
chunks.st: and he gave it to her in another place

chunks.en: it is valid. A woman who said, "Receive for me
chunks.st: the divorce is valid. With regard to the woman who when designating her agent for receipt said to her agent: Receive

chunks.en: my get in such-and-such a place,"
chunks.st: my bill of divorce for me in such and such a place,

chunks.en: and he received it for her in another place,
chunks.st: and he received it for her in another place,

chunks.en: it is not valid. Rabbi Eliezer says it is valid.
chunks.st: the divorce is invalid; and Rabbi Elazar deems it valid.

chunks.en: "Bring me my get from such-and-such a place,"
chunks.st: If she said to him: Bring me my bill of divorce from such and such a place,

chunks.en: and he brought it to her from another place, it is valid.
chunks.st: and he brought it for her from another place, it is valid.
chunks.stMore: Because he is an agent for delivery, the woman is not particular where he receives the bill of divorce, as the divorce takes effect only when the bill of divorce reaches her possession.

summary: A Kohen's wife may eat terumah until she is divorced. The mishnah tells when that happens, depending on what kind of messenger she sent.

chunks.en: If she said, "Bring me my get,"
chunks.st: An Israelite woman married to a priest partakes of teruma. If she says to an agent: Bring me my bill of divorce,
chunks.stMore: designating him as an agent for delivery,

chunks.he: אוֹכֶלֶת בַּתְּרוּמָה עַד שֶׁיַּגִּיעַ גֵּט לְיָדָהּ.
chunks.en: she may eat terumah until the get reaches her hand.
chunks.st: she continues to partake of teruma until the bill of divorce reaches her possession.

chunks.en: If "Receive my get for me,"
chunks.st: However, if she says: Receive my bill of divorce for me,
chunks.stMore: thereby designating him as an agent for receipt,

chunks.en: she may not eat terumah from right away.
chunks.st: it is immediately prohibited for her to partake of teruma.
chunks.stMore: Since the divorce takes effect when the husband hands the bill of divorce to the agent, the concern is that the agent encountered the husband nearby.

chunks.en: If "Receive my get for me in such-and-such a place,"
chunks.st: If the woman said to the agent: Receive my bill of divorce for me in such and such a place,
chunks.stMore: then even if he received it elsewhere,

chunks.en: she may eat terumah until
chunks.st: she continues to partake of teruma until

chunks.en: the get reaches that place.
chunks.st: the bill of divorce reaches that place.

chunks.en: Rabbi Eliezer forbids it right away.
chunks.st: Rabbi Elazar prohibits her from partaking of teruma immediately.

summary: Some words clearly tell people to write a get, and some do not. The mishnah also tells when a man going into danger only needs to say "write," and they also give it.

chunks.en: Someone who says, "Write a get and give it to my wife,"
chunks.st: With regard to a husband who says to two people: Write a bill of divorce and give it to my wife,

chunks.en: or "Divorce her," or "Write a letter and give it to her,"
chunks.st: or: Divorce her, or: Write a letter and give it to her,

chunks.en: they should write it and give it.
chunks.st: they should write the document and give it to her.
chunks.stMore: In each of those cases his intent is clear. He is instructing them to effect her divorce. However, one who said:

chunks.en: But "Send her off," "Take care of her,"
chunks.st: Release her, or: Sustain her,

chunks.en: "Treat her by the law,"
chunks.st: or: Treat her according to the law [nimus],

chunks.en: "Treat her properly,"
chunks.st: or: Treat her appropriately,

chunks.en: did not say anything.
chunks.st: said nothing,
chunks.stMore: as none of these expressions clearly expresses his desire to divorce his wife.

chunks.en: At first they used to say,
chunks.st: At first the Sages would say:

chunks.en: someone being taken out in chains who said,
chunks.explain: He was being taken to be punished by the government.
chunks.st: In the case of one who is taken out in a neck chain [kolar] to be executed and who said:

chunks.en: "Write a get for my wife,"
chunks.st: Write a bill of divorce for my wife,

chunks.en: they should write it and give it.
chunks.st: these people should write the document and give it to his wife even though there was no explicit instruction to give it to her.

chunks.en: Then they said,
chunks.st: They then said:

chunks.en: even one who sails off, or goes out with a caravan.
chunks.st: Even with regard to one who sets sail and one who departs in a caravan
chunks.stMore: to a far-off place and says: Write a bill of divorce to my wife, his intention is to write the bill of divorce and give it to his wife.

chunks.en: Rabbi Shimon Shezuri says,
chunks.st: Rabbi Shimon Shezuri says:

chunks.en: even one who is in great danger.
chunks.st: Even if one who is dangerously ill gives that instruction, they write the bill of divorce and give it to his wife.

summary: A man in danger who asks people to write a get for his wife wants them to give it too. But a healthy man who says only "write" may be joking.

chunks.en: Someone who was thrown into a pit and said,
chunks.st: With regard to one who was thrown into a pit
chunks.stMore: and thought that he would die there, and he said that

chunks.en: whoever hears his voice
chunks.st: anyone who hears his voice

chunks.en: should write a get for his wife,
chunks.st: should write a bill of divorce for his wife,
chunks.stMore: and he specified his name, her name, and all relevant details,

chunks.en: they should write it and give it.
chunks.st: those who hear him should write this bill of divorce and give it to his wife,
chunks.stMore: even though they do not see the man and do not know him.

chunks.en: A healthy man who said,
chunks.st: A healthy man who said:

chunks.en: "Write a get for my wife,"
chunks.st: Write a bill of divorce for my wife,
chunks.stMore: but did not say to give it to her,

chunks.en: maybe he wanted to tease her.
chunks.st: presumably sought to mock her.
chunks.stMore: Since he told them to write the bill of divorce and not to give it, it is not a valid bill of divorce. The mishna relates:

chunks.en: Once a healthy man said,
chunks.st: There was an incident involving a healthy man who said:

chunks.en: "Write a get for my wife,"
chunks.st: Write a bill of divorce for my wife,

chunks.en: and he went up on the roof, fell, and died.
chunks.st: and then ascended to the roof and fell, and died.

chunks.en: Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel said,
chunks.st: Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel

chunks.en: the Sages said,
chunks.st: said:
chunks.basisNote: Steinsaltz leaves out these words; Bartenura has them.

chunks.en: if he fell on his own,
chunks.st: If he fell at his own initiative, taking his own life,

chunks.en: it is a get.
chunks.st: it is a valid bill of divorce,
chunks.stMore: as it is clear that he anticipated his death and instructed those listening to write the bill of divorce with the intent of giving it to her.

chunks.en: If the wind pushed him,
chunks.st: However, if the wind forced him to fall,

chunks.en: it is not a get.
chunks.st: it is not a valid bill of divorce, as there was no clear intent to give her the bill of divorce.

summary: When a man tells people to write or give a get, the number of people and his exact words decide who writes it and who signs it.

chunks.en: If he said to two people,
chunks.st: If a man said to two people:

chunks.en: "Give a get to my wife,"
chunks.st: Give a bill of divorce to my wife, or

chunks.en: or to three,
chunks.st: if a man said to three people:

chunks.en: "Write a get and give it to my wife,"
chunks.st: Write a bill of divorce and give it to my wife,

chunks.en: they should write it and give it.
chunks.st: these people should write the document themselves and give it to her.

chunks.en: If he said to three,
chunks.st: If he said to three people:

chunks.en: "Give a get to my wife,"
chunks.st: Give a bill of divorce to my wife,

chunks.en: they should tell others to write it,
chunks.st: these people should tell others, and those others will write the document,

chunks.en: because he made them a beis din.
chunks.st: because he designated the three people as a court.

chunks.en: These are the words of Rabbi Meir.
chunks.st: This is the statement of Rabbi Meir.

chunks.en: And this is the halacha that Rabbi Chanina
chunks.st: And it is that halakha that Rabbi Ḥanina

chunks.en: from Ono brought up from prison:
chunks.explain: He learned it from Rabbi Akiva in prison.
chunks.st: of Ono brought up from prison in the name of Rabbi Akiva, who was incarcerated there:

chunks.en: "I have learned that one who says to three,
chunks.st: I received a tradition from my teachers that in a case where a man says to three people:

chunks.en: 'Give a get to my wife,'
chunks.st: Give a bill of divorce to my wife,

chunks.en: they should tell others to write it,
chunks.st: that these people should tell others and those others will write the document,

chunks.en: because he made them a beis din."
chunks.st: because he designated the three people as a court.

chunks.en: Rabbi Yosei said,
chunks.st: Rabbi Yosei said:

chunks.en: we said to the messenger,
chunks.st: We said [nomeinu] to the agent, Rabbi Ḥanina of Ono:

chunks.en: we too have learned,
chunks.st: We too received a tradition.
chunks.stMore: However, it is a different one,

chunks.he: שֶׁאֲפִלּוּ אָמַר לְבֵית דִּין הַגָּדוֹל שֶׁבִּירוּשָׁלַיִם,
chunks.en: that even if he said to the great beis din in Yerushalayim,
chunks.st: that even if a man said to the High Court [Sanhedrin] in Jerusalem:

chunks.en: "Give a get to my wife,"
chunks.st: Give a bill of divorce to my wife,

chunks.en: they should learn how, write it, and give it.
chunks.st: that the members of the court should learn to write, and should write the document themselves, and give it to his wife.

chunks.en: If he said to ten,
chunks.st: If a man said to ten people:

chunks.en: "Write a get for my wife,"
chunks.st: Write and give a bill of divorce to my wife,

chunks.en: one writes and two sign.
chunks.st: one of the ten writes the bill of divorce and two sign it.

chunks.en: "All of you write,"
chunks.st: If he said: All of you write the document,

chunks.en: one writes and all of them sign.
chunks.st: one of them writes the bill of divorce and all of them sign it.

chunks.en: So if one of them died,
chunks.st: Therefore, if one of them died,

chunks.en: this get is cancelled.
chunks.st: then this is a bill of divorce that is null and void, as he directed all of them to participate in the process.
